mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months where FEDFUNDS declined (FEDFUNDS[t-1mo] < FEDFUNDS[t-2mo]) over the 5-year period ending 2022-10-15.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over the 5-year period ending 2022-10-15.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals monetary easing coinciding with supply strengthening, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations for positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months where FEDFUNDS declined and INDPRO increased over the 5-year period ending 2022-10-15.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE rose over the 5-year period ending 2022-10-15.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month signals strengthening supply capacity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months where INDPRO increased (INDPRO[t-1mo] > INDPRO[t-2mo]) over the 5-year period ending 2022-10-15.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 (thousands), it signals a weakening real estate market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where HOUST < 1200.0 over the 5-year period ending 2022-10-15.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals broad-based weakening in consumer and business demand, reducing earnings growth expectations and causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where HOUST declined and INDPRO declined over the 5-year period ending 2022-10-15.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the prior 3 months signals disinflation, reducing real interest rate expectations and increasing equity valuations for positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months where CPIAUCSL declined (CPIAUCSL[t-1mo] < CPIAUCSL[t-3mo]) over the 5-year period ending 2022-10-15.
